Looking for a surface… move slowly
Too far away. Get closer than 5 metres

Measure real-world distances by placing two points on AR-detected surfaces.

string-array.name: aruler_help_requirements
string-array.item: Good lighting and a textured surface (wood, fabric, etc.).
Move the phone in a “figure-8” pattern to help plane detection.
In devices with Depth API support, surface detection on walls is significantly better.

string-array.name: aruler_help_steps
string-array.item: Move the phone slowly until the green message \"Aim at the first point\" appears.
Center the crosshair on the first point and tap +.
Move the phone to the second point: the line and measurement update in real-time.
Tap + again to confirm. The measurement is fixed and added to history.
In Path mode, you can chain multiple segments and tap ✓ to close; the total is shown.

string-array.name: aruler_help_buttons
string-array.item: Segment / Path: switches between measuring a single segment or chaining several with a total.
Undo: removes the last point placed, or the last measurement if none is in progress.
Clear: deletes all measurements.
m / ft: switches between metric and imperial systems.
+ (large button): places a point. It\'s gray when there is no valid surface.
✕ in history: deletes that specific measurement.

string-array.name: aruler_help_tips
string-array.item: Good lighting and textured surfaces provide much more stable measurements.
To measure on a smooth wall, move sideways a few centimeters before aiming.
Beyond 5 meters, the app won\'t let you mark: precision is no longer reliable there.
Numbers are purposefully rounded (half a centimeter, one centimeter, or five depending on distance).
The measurement is fixed upon confirmation. If the points move on screen, the distance does not change.

string-array.name: aruler_help_troubles
string-array.item: \"Detects nothing\": move slowly side to side for a few seconds so the map can be built.
\"Doesn\'t detect the wall\": a smooth white wall has no texture to detect. Aim at the frame, baseboard, or any high-contrast edge.
\"Points move\": it\'s normal for them to shift a few millimeters; the measured distance remains the same.
\"+ button is gray\": no valid surface in the crosshair, or it\'s more than 5 meters away.

resources.string: The camera is used only for measurement; no photos or videos are recorded.
